overview_description.description:
Wibond is a white-label fintech platform, ready to operate, that enables any company to offer financial services like payments, wallets, and loans.
It adapts to each client’s needs to optimize cash flow and generate additional revenue.
Wibond was founded in Argentina in 2020 by Ezequiel Bucai and Alejandro Silvestre. In 2013 they created a platform where users accessed a network of more than 2,500 gyms and sports centers located in 30 cities in Argentina, Mexico and Chile. Then Classpass, the US Unicorn, acquired Clickypass.

product.name: Módulo Wallet (Wallet Module)
product.description: A white-label digital wallet platform that enables creation and management of branded digital accounts with features like instant transfers, prepaid cards, bill payments, and automated investments.

product.name: Módulo Lending (Lending Module)
product.description: An integrated lending service providing automated credit evaluation, risk management, capital access, and collections to offer flexible loans and advances to a business’s network.

product.name: Módulo Payments (Payments Module)
product.description: A white-label payment processing system integrating multiple online and in-person payment methods, including payment links, QR codes, SmartPOS, and installment payments.
